An entry pins the one anonymous `extern struct { ... } symbol;` declaration in the listed header token for token and permits volatile only on its bit-field members of listed types, and only while config/data_symbols.json maps the symbol to the listed address. Volatile in any source file, on any other object or in any other header still fails. ONLY the repository maintainer may add an entry; agents park the function and cite the evidence instead.
